items.prompt: For the single item 2 and target 4, why does the implementation update ways[4] before ways[2]?

options.text: To make ways[4] see the newly updated ways[2].
options.why: That would reuse the same item index twice.

options.text: So ways[4] reads the previous-item count at 2, still 0.
options.why: Descending totals preserve the 0/1 dependency on the earlier item layer.

options.text: To discard every subset whose sum is even.
options.why: The order controls item reuse, not parity eligibility.

options.text: To make the answer independent of ways[0].
options.why: The base count remains essential for starting subsets.

items.explanation: Descending totals preserve the 0/1 dependency on the earlier item layer.
